verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a simulator, since a simulator could ship trigger/action features, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only developer building blocks: custom C++ plugins (gazebo-gh-1), pub/sub messaging (gazebo-docs-36) and launch configuration scripts (gazebo-docs-38). None of these is a documented way to define rules that automatically fire actions on events, and building blocks earn no credit.
